key_concepts: Atomic theory views matter as composed of atoms
In neutral atoms, protons equal electrons and mass number equals protons plus neutrons
Electron configuration shows how electrons are distributed among orbitals and energy level
Shorthand electron configuration starts with the previous noble gas symbol
Valence electrons are outermost electrons that participate in bonding; core electrons do n
Absorbing energy excites an electron to a higher energy level; releasing energy returns it
Aufbau principle states electrons fill lowest energy orbitals first
Pauli exclusion principle allows only two electrons in a single orbital
Hund's rule states electrons singly occupy empty orbitals before pairing
Orbital diagrams are pictorial descriptions of electrons in orbitals
Quantum numbers n, l, m_l, and m_s give the address of an electron
Heisenberg uncertainty principle and Schrodinger model describe electron location only as
